icon_style.CRITICAL: ONLY ONE OBJECT. Never include secondary items, decorations, garnishes, or accessories. Single subject only.
icon_style.perspective: flat front-facing, perfectly centered, no tilt or angle

geometry.element_arrangement: single centered object only, no accompaniments

composition.element_count: exactly 1 object, no secondary elements, no decorations, no garnishes
composition.spatial_depth: flat 2D with no depth or perspective
composition.scene_density: minimal - object only, no props or extras

lighting.type: flat, even lighting with no directional source
lighting.contrast: medium - subtle gradients only for material definition
lighting.highlighting: minimal, only subtle gradients to suggest metallic sheen

textures.material_finish: smooth metallic gold/bronze with subtle wood grain
textures.surface_treatment: flat stylized with minimal texture detail
textures.detail_level: simple and clean, no complex textures

color_palette.tone: warm golden bronze and rich brown wood tones
color_palette.color_variety: golden yellows, bronze oranges, warm browns
color_palette.usage: glowing orange rim effect around golden metallic frame

icon_style.stylistic_tone: flat, clean, UI button style, fantasy game aesthetic

constraints.no_text: no text, labels, or typography of any kind
constraints.no_3d: absolutely no isometric view, no 3D effect, no depth, no perspective

ui_validation.button_test: works as tappable UI element background
ui_validation.overlay_test: center area works for icon overlay
